summary: Salesforce announced on 20 Oct it will buy Braze for $47.50 a share in cash (about $5.66bn enterprise value, closing in fiscal 2028), folding Braze into Marketing Cloud and Agentforce. Reports have CRM shares dipping roughly 2.6-3% on the news before the US open, the usual acquirer discount, while Braze jumps on a ~50% premium. Strategically sensible but adds cost and integration risk, so a small negative for the near term. Mentions are only modestly above recent days.
